Basic ATC

Lanjutkan melalui

An ATC instruction directing an aircraft to follow a specified route, airway, or series of waypoints.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Lanjutkan melalui?

In this glossary, Lanjutkan melalui refers to: An ATC instruction directing an aircraft to follow a specified route, airway, or series of waypoints.

How is Lanjutkan melalui used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ATC: N789EF, lanjutkan melalui jalur udara VICTOR 12 ke titik CHARLIE."

Why does Lanjutkan melalui matter in aviation?

Lanjutkan melalui matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Lanjutkan melalui?

Lanjutkan melalui is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Lanjutkan melalui belong to?

In this glossary, Lanjutkan melalui is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

An ATC instruction directing an aircraft to follow a specified route, airway, or series of waypoints.

Operational example

ATC: N789EF, proceed via VICTOR 12 airway to CHARLIE waypoint.

Localized term

Lanjutkan melalui

Localized example

ATC: N789EF, lanjutkan melalui jalur udara VICTOR 12 ke titik CHARLIE.
